def: A learned encoder, quantizer and decoder that compresses audio into a low-bitrate stream of discrete tokens and reconstructs the waveform from them.
practice: SoundStream, EnCodec and DAC use residual vector quantization and serve as tokenizers for codec-based TTS, speech-to-speech and music models; SoundStream at 3 kbps beat Opus at 12 kbps in listening tests.
